# Vanguard Residential Tower

> Franck Muller Vanguard is a luxury residential tower rising in Dubai Marina, created with the Swiss watchmaker whose Vanguard collection lends the building its name and façade detailing. It holds about 722 studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments across 34 floors above four basement parking levels. Facilities include a gym, swimming pool, tennis court, sauna and steam room, co-working space, children's playground and a Franck Muller lounge.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

Franck Muller Vanguard is a luxury residential tower in Dubai Marina, developed by London Gate in collaboration with Swiss watchmaker Franck Muller and offering 722 studio to three-bedroom apartments above four basement parking levels. MENASCO is delivering the full MEP scope, covering HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems tailored to high-end residential living, with smart-living technologies and energy-efficient solutions.
